_comment: One station copied verbatim from can-api's data/atis/config.json (served unauthenticated at GET /api/v1/atis/config), plus the version field its handler injects. It pins the wire shape both sides agree on: a key renamed in can-api, or a serde field renamed in profile.rs, reads as a default rather than an error, so only a fixture like this notices. Refresh it only when can-api's shape deliberately changes.
notes: 华东、华北六个主要机场的通播配置。跑道构型分预设，中英双语播出。情报字母是运行状态，不在这份配置里。
